name: Altadena drill site
goal: Boxwork edge: first drill of the campaign
why: Curiosity drilled here (its 43rd hole) at the edge of the boxwork unit, June 2025.
sources: Curiosity position on sol 4564: NASA MMGIS MSL waypoints

name: Top of the ramp: main boxwork
why: After an 11 m sand-covered ramp the rover reached the top of the ridge and the start of the main boxwork region.
sources: Curiosity position on sol 4600: NASA MMGIS MSL waypoints

name: Scenic overlook (360 panorama)
why: A look-about stop picked from HiRISE images to photograph the right-angle ridge pattern.
sources: Curiosity position on sol 4611: NASA MMGIS MSL waypoints

name: Valle de la Luna (hollow drill)
why: Bedrock drilled in the Monte Grande hollow (44th hole), Oct 2025: the "low" of the ridge/hollow pair.
sources: Curiosity position on sol 4693: NASA MMGIS MSL waypoints

name: Nevado Sajama (ridge drill)
why: Ridge-top bedrock drilled Nov 2025 (45th hole), the "high" of the pair, to compare with Valle de la Luna.
sources: Curiosity position on sol 4718: NASA MMGIS MSL waypoints
